name: Basic Dev Container
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -eux; if command -v sudo >/dev/null; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl git; else apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl git; fi; mkdir -p /workspaces/agent_tests; if id -u vscode >/dev/null 2>&1; then if command -v sudo >/dev/null; then sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /workspaces/agent_tests || true; else chown -R vscode:vscode /workspaces/agent_tests || true; fi; else echo 'User vscode not found in image, skipping chown'; fi'
